title: Trainin Day
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael prepares to leave Dunder Mifflin after 19 years, meeting the new manager Deangelo Vickers for the first time. Deangelo introduces himself and attempts to establish his management style, leading to mixed reactions from the office staff. Dwight expresses disappointment about not being made manager and seeks advice on advancing at Sabre. Meanwhile, Jim and Pam share a positive moment involving their daughter Cece, and Andy provides comic relief with his antics. The episode explores themes of change, leadership, and office dynamics.
